hook: A massive $10 billion defamation suit just vanished in federal court.

sections.voiceover: A massive $10 billion defamation suit just vanished in federal court.
b_roll: Miami federal courthouse exterior with graphic crossing out ten billion dollars

sections.voiceover: On October 31, 2026, Judge Darrin Gayles dismissed Donald Trump's lawsuit in Miami. The filing targeted Rupert Murdoch over a July 2025 story about Jeffrey Epstein. Where did the $10 billion claim fail?
b_roll: Headshots of Rupert Murdoch and Donald Trump beside media reporting text

sections.voiceover: Except the court found actual malice was never plausibly alleged.
b_roll: Legal text highlighting the actual malice threshold standard

sections.voiceover: Judge Gayles ruled that Donald Trump failed to prove actual malice against Dow Jones. Because of that failure, the judge dismissed the lawsuit with prejudice. That ruling officially ended the $10 billion legal battle.
b_roll: The Wall Street Journal logo on office building exterior
Official court order stating case dismissed with prejudice

sections.voiceover: The $10 billion lawsuit remains dismissed with prejudice.
